# Clean House Melbourne

> > Professional 5-star hotel standard house cleaning and home management services across Melbourne with 1300+ verified reviews and 100% satisfaction guarantee.

Clean House Melbourne is a trusted residential and commercial cleaning service provider in Melbourne offering specialized services from regular cleaning to luxury housekeeping, end-of-lease cleaning, and premium home concierge. The company is NDIS verified, ISO certified, and employs professionally trained cleaners using eco-friendly products with flexible scheduling options.
